versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Each SwCluC_LdComProxy_LdCom- CbkStartOfReception notification callback, where the parameter LdComUser- CallbackType (See [ECUC_LdCom_00025]) is set to LDCOM_TP_COPY_RX_DATA , shall be configured as SwCluC_LdComProxy_<BS>_LdComCbkCopyRxData , where <BS> is the shortName of the SwCluCLdComProxyBaseSocket container.
